what: Jobs of the process displacement-series on a private copy of the web service, run with uvicorn from the clone at the commit below in the environment of the checks, on the layers of received.json
served_status: api/ as committed; uncommitted changes in web/ and docs/ only

answer.title: Displacement series
answer.description: Give the movement of the ground at a point on many dates, relative to a reference point, from GUNW pairs.

inputs.title: Input layers
inputs.description: The id of each input layer, in any order. A layer is given once.

point.title: Point
point.description: The point of the series, in degrees of longitude and latitude (WGS 84). Without it the series is that of the whole area of the layers.

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: The reference point of a series that is relative to one, in degrees of longitude and latitude (WGS 84). Only the tool displacement-series takes one, and it needs one.

series.title: Series
series.description: The description of the series that the job produced, with the value of every date.

result.title: Displacement HH at p1
result.quantity: Displacement along the line of sight, relative to the reference point
result.method: Small-baseline inversion of the unwrapped phase of the pairs at the cell of the point, each pair referenced to the cell of the reference point, with equal weights and the minimum-norm velocity, the first date being zero, times -wavelength/(4*pi); relative to the reference point, not corrected for the ionosphere, the troposphere or the solid Earth tides (Berardino et al., 2002, https://doi.org/10.1109/TGRS.2002.803792; Yunjun et al., 2019, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cageo.2019.104331; MintPy 1.6.4, reference_point and ifgram_inversion with --weight-func no and --mask-dset connectComponent)

a pair left out at the point.message: At the point, the phase of 1 of the 9 pairs is not reliable relative to the reference point, and the other pairs do not link all the dates into one network.

a reference without a reliable phase in.message: The reference point has no reliable phase in the layer "Unwrapped phase HH, 9 Oct 2026 to 21 Oct 2026", so choose a reference point with one in every pair.

pairs that do not link all the dates.message: The pairs do not link all their dates into one network, so the movement between the separate groups of dates is unknown.

no reference point.message: The tool gives the series relative to a reference point, and no reference point was given.

a reference point outside the area.message: The reference point lies outside the area of the layers.

the point in the cell of the reference.message: The point and the reference point lie in the same cell of the layers.

answer.title: Bad Request
answer.detail: The input reference.longitude is not valid: Input should be less than or equal to 180.
